name: notebook-bridge
description: Local VS Code notebook bridge for Codex and Claude Code sidebars.

hithiumNotebookBridge.autoStart.description: Start the local notebook bridge when VS Code finishes startup.

hithiumNotebookBridge.port.description: Localhost port for the bridge. Use 0 to let the OS choose a free port.

hithiumNotebookBridge.connectionFile.description: Workspace-relative file where the bridge writes its endpoint and bearer token.

hithiumNotebookBridge.workspaceOnly.description: Allow notebook edits only inside the current VS Code workspace, except for the explicitly active notebook when editActiveNotebookOnly is enabled.

hithiumNotebookBridge.editActiveNotebook.description: Allow edits only to the currently active notebook editor.

hithiumNotebookBridge.maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

hithiumNotebookBridge.saveAfterEdit.description: Save the notebook after a successful edit unless the request overrides save.
